## Progress

- Merged [PR #31](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/31): audit.AuditEvents is an append-only SQL ledger table with tenant RLS; `.Audited()` endpoint filter writes one event per request and fails closed; ledger digest verification test; mutation-checked
- Merged [PR #50](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/50): endpoint enumeration test: every signed-in endpoint is `.Audited(...)` or reviewed as free of patient data (fails closed), and every audited endpoint writes exactly one audit row per request
- Merged [PR #58](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/58): denied attempts audited: a request the policy refuses on an `.Audited()` endpoint writes one event with outcome Denied (`AuditDeniedAccess`), so each patient-data request leaves exactly one event either way; mutation-checked
- Review fix (PR #66): the enumeration test now calls every audited endpoint once per staff role, so both the allowed and the refused path must write exactly one row, and fails if no role gets past authorization (before, patient endpoints were only ever refused)
- Open [PR #68](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/68): one outcome rule in the `.Audited()` filter, which now writes after the endpoint answers and before the answer is sent (401/403 → Denied, 404 → new NotFound, else Allowed); Scheduling maps its errors inside the filter, so a refused scheduling call is no longer audited as Allowed; clinic queries no longer refetch audited reads on tab focus or retry 4xx; mutation-checked
- Left: refusals are recorded only for callers with a tenant, which real sessions get with the facility picker (MDV-P0-012); daily digest export to immutable Blob (needs Azure, MDV-P0-006)

## Description

AUDIT_EVENT as an append-only ledger table: actor, tenant, facility, patient ref (opaque id), action, resource ref, purpose, outcome (allowed/denied), timestamp, IP, correlation id — no PHI values. A mediator behaviour and endpoint filter write an event for every read and write of patient data, sign-in, export and permission change. Ledger digests are exported daily to immutable Blob and verified by a scheduled job.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every endpoint tagged as patient-data read or write produces exactly one audit event per request (test enumerates endpoints).
- [ ] **AC2.** The app identity cannot UPDATE or DELETE audit rows (permission test); ledger verification detects a tampered row in a test database.
- [ ] **AC3.** Audit events contain opaque patient ids only; a test scans payloads for names, phone numbers and identifiers and fails if found.
- [ ] **AC4.** Daily digest export to an immutable (time-based retention) container succeeds and verification runs on schedule with an alert on mismatch.
- [ ] **AC5.** Denied authorization attempts are audited with outcome "denied".

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
